source: Community spreadsheet Damage_plotting.xlsx by another PrUn player, shared with the user 2026-08-09. Tabs used: 'KQ-451' (BTF series at two shielding levels), 'Main sheet' (meteoroid density fit), 'Planet damage' (landing damage fit), 'Planet orbits' (FIO planet pull).
description: Only the parts this repo verified are carried. Their per-planet FIO pull is NOT duplicated here: the fields that matter (Sunlight, OrbitSemiMajorAxisAU, MagneticField, Pressure, Temperature, Radius, Gravity) come from FIO directly.

luminosityLaw.verified: Constant within every one of the 698 systems to one part in 10^7 (worst spread 1.0000001 across all 4,576 planets). Any single planet yields its system's luminosity.

kq451Series.note: Nine legs, 2 AU to 490 AU around KQ-451 (O class, L = 2,175,923), at two shielding levels. Their own 0.0002 %/Mkm floor subtracted. Fitting rate = C x L / (r1 x r2) — the path average of 1/r^2 — holds C to +/-11% over 250x in radius and 18,000x in rate. Their distance column does not reconcile with a radial path, so the absolute C is not comparable to the BTF campaign's; the SHAPE and the shielding ratio are what transfer.
kq451Series.shieldingRatio: Exactly 3.34x between the two variants on all nine bands — stellar shielding is multiplicative.

meteoroidCrossCheck.note: Independent fits from different flights, agreeing to 9% and 1.3%. Their KQ-451 rates converge on exactly 0.0002 %/Mkm far from the star despite KQ-451's density being 4.62 (which alone would give 0.00254) — that series was flown shielded, so whipple nulls the meteoroid term entirely and the flat term is not meteoroid.

landingDamageCandidate.note: Best of seven candidate fits on their 'Planet damage' tab against FIO Pressure and the panel's landing length. Addresses shipping-calibration.md section 6's unresolved per-planet LND term. NOT verified by this repo.

otherTabs.KI-439: ~70 real (non-BTF) flights between two planets of one system with orbital phase angles — the dataset for same-system transit timing.
